title.zh: 卷三百二十四 列傳第二百十二 外國五 占城 真臘 暹羅 瓜哇 三佛齊
title.en: Volume 324 Biographies 212: Foreign States 5 - Champa, Khmer Empire, Siam, Java, Srivijaya
title.raw: 卷三百二十四 列傳第二百十二 外國五 占城 真臘 暹羅 瓜哇 三佛齊 Volume 324 Biographies 212: Foreign States 5 - Champa, Khmer Empire, Siam, Java, Srivijaya

sentences.zh: 占城居南海中，自瓊州航海順風一晝夜可至，自福州西南行十晝夜可至，即周 越裳地。

translations.literal: Champa lies in the midst of the Southern Sea; sailing from Qiongzhou with a favorable wind one can reach it in a day and a night, and from Fuzhou going southwest one can reach it in ten days and nights; it is the land of Yueshang of the Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Champa lay in the South Sea. From Qiongzhou, a ship running before a fair wind could reach it in a single day and night; from Fuzhou, sailing southwest, the voyage took ten days and nights. This was the Yueshang country of the Zhou dynasty.

sentences.zh: 秦為林邑，漢為象林縣。

translations.literal: Under the Qin it was Linyi; under the Han it was Xianglin County.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qin it was known as Linyi; under the Han it became Xianglin County.

sentences.zh: 後漢末，區連據其地，始稱林邑王。

translations.literal: At the end of the Later Han, Qu Lian seized this territory and first styled himself King of Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Later Han, Qu Lian seized the region and first took the title King of Linyi.

sentences.zh: 自晉至隋仍 之。

translations.literal: From the Jin through the Sui it remained thus.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jin through the Sui dynasties, the arrangement continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 唐時，或稱占不勞，或稱占婆，其王所居曰占城。

translations.literal: In Tang times it was sometimes called Chanbula, sometimes Zhanpo; the place where its king resided was called Champa.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tang, the realm was known variously as Chanbula or Zhanpo, while the king's seat was called Champa.

sentences.zh: 至德後，改國號曰環。

translations.literal: After the Zhide era, the state name was changed to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhide reign period, the country changed its name to Huan.

sentences.zh: 迄周、 宋，遂以占城為號，朝貢不替。

translations.literal: Down through the Zhou and Song, they then took Champa as their designation, and tribute missions never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Zhou and Song dynasties the state came to be known as Champa, and its tribute missions to the court never lapsed.

sentences.zh: 元世祖惡其阻命，大舉兵擊破之，亦不能定。

translations.literal: Yuan Shizu hated their defiance of orders; he raised a great army, defeated and broke them, yet still could not subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai Khan resented their disobedience, launched a major campaign that shattered their forces, and still could not bring them fully under control.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，太祖遣官以即位詔諭其國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, the Founding Emperor dispatched officials with an accession edict to announce to their country.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2, the Hongwu Emperor sent officials bearing an enthronement edict to notify the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 其王阿荅阿者先已遣使奉表來朝，貢象 虎方物。

translations.literal: Its king A-da-a-zhe had already beforehand sent envoys bearing a memorial to come to court, offering elephants, tigers, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: King A-da-a-zhe had already sent envoys ahead with a formal memorial, coming to court to present elephants, tigers, and other tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，即遣官齎璽書、《大統歷》、文綺、紗羅，偕其使者往賜，其王復 遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Emperor was pleased and immediately dispatched officials bearing a seal-letter, the Datong Calendar, patterned silks, and gauze and silk, going together with their envoys to bestow them; the king again sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was delighted and at once sent officials with an imperial seal-letter, the Datong Calendar, fine silks, gauzes, and brocades, who traveled back with the Champa envoys to deliver the gifts; the king then sent tribute again.

sentences.zh: 自後或比歲貢，或間歲，或一歲再貢。

translations.literal: From afterward, sometimes they offered tribute every year, sometimes every other year, sometimes twice in one year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute came sometimes every year, sometimes every other year, and sometimes twice within a single year.

sentences.zh: 未幾，命中書省管勾甘桓、會同 館副使路景賢齎詔，封阿荅阿者為占城國王，賜彩幣四十、《大統歷》三千。

translations.literal: Before long, he ordered Gan Huan, clerical officer of the Secretariat, and Lu Jingxian, deputy commissioner of the Huitong Hostel, to carry an edict, investing A-da-a-zhe as King of Champa, and granted forty bolts of colored silk and three thousand copies of the Datong Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he ordered Secretariat clerk Gan Huan and Huitong Hostel deputy commissioner Lu Jingxian to deliver an edict investing A-da-a-zhe as King of Champa, along with forty bolts of colored silk and three thousand copies of the Datong Calendar.

sentences.zh: 三年 遣使往祀其山川，尋頒科舉詔於其國。

translations.literal: In the third year he dispatched envoys to sacrifice to their mountains and rivers; soon afterward he promulgated the civil examination edict in their country.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he sent envoys to perform sacrifices to the kingdom's mountains and rivers, and soon afterward issued the civil examination edict in the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 初，安南與占城構兵，天子遣使諭解，而安南復相侵。

translations.literal: At first Annam and Champa raised troops against each other; the Son of Heaven sent envoys to admonish and reconcile them, but Annam again invaded.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Annam and Champa had gone to war; the emperor sent envoys to counsel peace, but Annam invaded again.

sentences.zh: 四年，其王奉金葉表來 朝，長尺餘，廣五寸，刻本國字。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, its king came to court offering a gold-leaf memorial more than a foot long and five inches wide, inscribed in the script of their country.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the king came to court with a memorial written on gold leaf more than a foot long and five inches wide, carved in the Champa script.

sentences.zh: 館人譯之，其意曰：「大明皇帝登大寶位，撫有 四海，如天地覆載，日月照臨。

translations.literal: The hostel staff translated it; its meaning said: 'The Great Ming Emperor has ascended the great throne and cherishes all within the four seas, like heaven and earth covering and bearing, like sun and moon shining and overseeing.'
translations.idiomatic: Hostel interpreters rendered it as follows: "The Great Ming Emperor has ascended the imperial throne and holds the four seas in his care, as heaven and earth enfold all things, as the sun and moon shine upon the world."

sentences.zh: 阿荅阿者譬一草木爾，欽蒙遣使，以金印封為國王， 感戴忻悅，倍萬恆情。

translations.literal: A-da-a-zhe is like a single blade of grass; respectfully receiving the dispatched envoys and being sealed with a gold seal as king, I am moved with gratitude and joy, ten thousand times the ordinary feeling.
translations.idiomatic: "I, A-da-a-zhe, am no more than a blade of grass, yet I have been honored by your envoys and invested with a golden seal as king; my gratitude and joy exceed all measure."

sentences.zh: 惟是安南用兵，侵擾疆域，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: Only, Annam has deployed troops, harassing our territory, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: "But Annam has taken up arms, raiding our borders and slaughtering and plundering our officials and people."

sentences.zh: 伏願皇帝垂慈，賜以 兵器及樂器、樂人，俾安南知我占城乃聲教所被，輸貢之地，庶不敢欺陵。

translations.literal: I humbly hope the Emperor will extend compassion and grant weapons, as well as musical instruments and musicians, so that Annam may know that our Champa lies within the reach of civilizing instruction and is a land that pays tribute, and hopefully will not dare to bully and oppress us.
translations.idiomatic: "I humbly beg Your Majesty to show mercy and grant us weapons, musical instruments, and musicians, so that Annam may know Champa stands within the sway of imperial civilization and pays tribute to the throne, and will not dare to bully us further."

sentences.zh: 」帝命 禮部諭之曰：「占城、安南並事朝廷，同奉正朔，乃擅自構兵，毒害生靈，既失事 君之禮，又乖交鄰之道。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to instruct them, saying: 'Champa and Annam both serve the court and together observe the correct calendar; yet you have on your own raised troops, poisoning the living people—this both loses the rites of serving the sovereign and violates the way of neighboring states.'
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to reply: "Champa and Annam alike serve the court and observe the same calendar. To take up arms on your own and poison the people is both a breach of loyalty to the throne and a violation of the duties of neighboring states."

sentences.zh: 已咨安南國王，令即日罷兵。

translations.literal: Annam's king has already been consulted, and he has been ordered to cease troops that very day.
translations.idiomatic: "The King of Annam has already been instructed to halt hostilities at once."

sentences.zh: 本國亦宜講信修睦，各保疆 土。

translations.literal: Your country also ought to cultivate trust and good relations, each preserving your territory.
translations.idiomatic: "Your kingdom, too, should keep faith and live in amity, each guarding its own borders."

sentences.zh: 所請兵器，於王何吝，但兩國互構而賜占城，是助爾相攻，甚非撫安之義。

translations.literal: As for the requested weapons, what would the King begrudge you—but if the two countries are mutually at war and weapons are granted to Champa, that is aiding your mutual attacks, very much contrary to the meaning of pacification.
translations.idiomatic: "As for the weapons you request, the Emperor would not begrudge them—but while both realms are at war, to arm Champa would only help you destroy each other, which is hardly the way to bring peace."

sentences.zh: 樂 器、樂人，語音殊異，難以遣發。

translations.literal: Musical instruments and musicians—their speech is utterly different, and they are difficult to dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: "Musical instruments and performers cannot easily be sent, for their languages are wholly unlike your own."

sentences.zh: 爾國有曉華言者，其選擇以來，當令肄習。

translations.literal: If your country has persons who understand Chinese speech, select them to come; they will be ordered to study and practice.
translations.idiomatic: "If any in your realm understand Chinese, choose them and send them here; they will be trained accordingly."

sentences.zh: 」因 命福建省臣勿徵其稅，示懷柔之意。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ordered Fujian provincial officials not to levy their taxes, showing an intent of conciliation.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered officials in Fujian not to collect taxes from Champa merchants, as a gesture of goodwill.

sentences.zh: 六年，貢使言：「海寇張汝厚、林福等自稱元帥，剽劫海上。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, tribute envoys said: 'Sea bandits Zhang Ruhou, Lin Fu, and others styled themselves marshals and plundered on the sea.'
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the tribute envoys reported: "Sea pirates Zhang Ruhou, Lin Fu, and others proclaimed themselves marshals and raided the coast."

sentences.zh: 國主擊破之，賊 魁溺死，獲其舟二十艘、蘇木七萬斤，謹奉獻。

translations.literal: The state lord defeated and broke them; the bandit chiefs drowned to death; twenty ships and seventy thousand jin of sappanwood were captured and are respectfully presented.
translations.idiomatic: "Our king destroyed them; the ringleaders drowned; we captured twenty ships and seventy thousand jin of sappanwood, which we now respectfully present."

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉之，命給賜加等。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this and ordered enhanced grants and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended the deed and ordered extra gifts and rewards.

sentences.zh: 冬，遣使 獻安南之捷。

translations.literal: In winter, envoys were dispatched presenting the victory over Annam.
translations.idiomatic: That winter envoys were sent bearing news of victory over Annam.

sentences.zh: 帝謂省臣曰：「去冬，安南言占城犯境；

translations.literal: The Emperor said to the provincial officials: 'Last winter, Annam said Champa violated the border;'
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told his ministers: "Last winter Annam claimed that Champa had violated its borders;"

sentences.zh: 今年，占城謂安南擾邊，未 審曲直。

translations.literal: This year, Champa says Annam disturbed the frontier; right and wrong have not yet been examined.
translations.idiomatic: "this year Champa says Annam has harassed its frontier. We have not yet determined who is in the right."

sentences.zh: 可遣人往諭，各罷兵息民，毋相侵擾。

translations.literal: Envoys may be sent to instruct them; each should cease troops and quiet the people, and not mutually harass and invade.
translations.idiomatic: "Send envoys to counsel both sides to lay down arms, restore peace to their people, and refrain from further incursions."

sentences.zh: 」十年與安南王陳耑大戰，耑 敗死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he fought a great battle with Annam's king Chen Ri Kuan; Chen was defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he fought a major battle with the Annam king Chen Ri Kuan; Chen was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 十二年，貢使至都，中書不以時奏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, tribute envoys reached the capital, but the Secretariat did not memorialize in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when tribute envoys arrived at the capital, the Secretariat failed to report the matter promptly.

sentences.zh: 帝切責丞相胡惟庸、汪廣洋，二人遂獲 罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor sharply rebuked chief councillors Hu Weiyong and Wang Guangyang; the two men thereupon incurred guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sharply rebuked chief ministers Hu Weiyong and Wang Guangyang, and both men were punished.

sentences.zh: 遣官賜王《大統歷》及衣幣，令與安南修好罷兵。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to grant the king the Datong Calendar and robes and gifts, ordering him to restore good relations with Annam and cease troops.
translations.idiomatic: He sent officials to present the king with the Datong Calendar, robes, and gifts, and ordered him to make peace with Annam and end the fighting.

sentences.zh: 十三年遣使賀萬壽節。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Longevity Festival.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year envoys were sent to offer congratulations on the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 帝聞其與安南水戰不利，賜敕諭曰：「曩者安南兵出， 敗於占城。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that their naval battle with Annam went unfavorably, and granted an edict of instruction saying: 'Formerly, when Annam's troops went out, they were defeated by Champa.'
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Champa had fared poorly in naval fighting with Annam, the Emperor issued an edict: "When Annam's forces marched out before, they were beaten by Champa."

sentences.zh: 占城乘勝入安南，安南之辱已甚。

translations.literal: Champa, riding victory, entered Annam; Annam's humiliation was already extreme.
translations.idiomatic: "Champa then pressed its advantage into Annam, and Annam's disgrace was already deep enough."

sentences.zh: 王能保境息民，則福可長享；

translations.literal: If the King can preserve the borders and quiet the people, then blessings can long be enjoyed.
translations.idiomatic: "If you can hold your borders and give your people rest, your blessings may endure."

sentences.zh: 如必驅 兵苦戰，勝負不可知，而鷸蚌相持，漁人得利，他日悔之，不亦晚乎？

translations.literal: If you must drive troops to bitter battle, victory and defeat cannot be known; yet when snipe and clam hold each other, the fisherman obtains the profit—will it not be too late to regret on another day?
translations.idiomatic: "If you insist on driving your armies to endless war, the outcome is uncertain—and when the snipe and the clam grapple, it is the fisherman who wins. Will regret not come too late?"

sentences.zh: 」十六年貢 象牙二百枝及方物。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year they offered two hundred ivory tusks and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year they presented two hundred ivory tusks and other tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 遣官賜以勘合、文冊及織金文綺三十二、磁器萬九千。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to grant tally tokens, documents, thirty-two bolts of brocaded silk, and nineteen thousand pieces of porcelain.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to bestow tally tokens, certificates, thirty-two bolts of brocaded silk, and nineteen thousand pieces of porcelain.

sentences.zh: 十九年 遣子寶部領詩那日忽來朝，賀萬壽節，獻象五十四，皇太子亦有獻。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the son Ba Bu Ling Shi-na-ri Hu came to court, congratulating the Longevity Festival, presenting fifty-four elephants; the Crown Prince also had offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the king's son Ba Bu Ling Shi-na-ri Hu came to court for the birthday celebrations, presenting fifty-four elephants; the crown prince sent gifts as well.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其誠，賜 賚優渥，命中官送還。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised their sincerity and granted generous gifts and rewards, ordering eunuchs to escort them in returning.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised their sincerity, lavished gifts upon them, and ordered eunuchs to escort them home.

sentences.zh: 明年復貢象五十一及伽南、犀角諸物，帝加宴賚。

translations.literal: The next year they again offered fifty-one elephants, agarwood, rhinoceros horn, and various items; the Emperor added feast rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they sent fifty-one more elephants, along with agarwood, rhinoceros horn, and other goods; the Emperor added a banquet and further rewards.

sentences.zh: 還至廣東， 覆命中官宴餞，給道里費。

translations.literal: When they reached Guangdong, again eunuchs were ordered to host a farewell banquet and provide road expenses.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Guangdong, eunuchs were again ordered to give them a farewell banquet and traveling expenses.

sentences.zh: 真臘貢象，占城王奪其四之一，其他失德事甚多。

translations.literal: When Chenla offered elephants, the King of Champa seized one-fourth of them; other deeds of lost virtue were also very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenla sent elephants as tribute, the King of Champa seized a quarter of them; many other acts of misconduct besides.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，怒。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, he was angry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard of this, he was enraged.

sentences.zh: 二十一年夏， 命行人董紹敕責之。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year, he ordered the courier Dong Shao to go with an edict rebuking him.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-first year he dispatched courier Dong Shao with an edict of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 紹未至，而其貢使抵京。

translations.literal: Shao had not yet arrived, but their tribute envoys reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Before Shao arrived, Champa's tribute envoys reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋復遣使謝罪，乃命宴賜如制。

translations.literal: Soon they again dispatched envoys to apologize and seek pardon; thereupon he ordered feasts and grants according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: They soon sent envoys again to apologize, whereupon the Emperor ordered the usual feasts and gifts.

sentences.zh: 時阿荅阿者失道，大臣閣勝懷不軌謀，二十三年弒王自立。

translations.literal: At that time A-da-a-zhe had lost the Way; the great minister Ge Sheng harbored a treacherous design, and in the twenty-third year he assassinated the king and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: By then A-da-a-zhe had lost his moral authority; his chief minister Ge Sheng plotted treason, and in the twenty-third year he murdered the king and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 明年遣太師奉表來 貢，帝惡其悖逆，卻之。

translations.literal: The next year he dispatched the Grand Preceptor bearing a memorial to offer tribute; the Emperor detested his rebellion and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the usurper sent his Grand Preceptor with a tribute memorial, but the Emperor, loathing his treachery, refused it.

sentences.zh: 三十年後，復連入貢。

translations.literal: After thirty years, they again came repeatedly offering tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty years later they resumed sending tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 成祖即位，詔諭其國。

translations.literal: When Chengzu took the throne, he issued an edict announcing to their country.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongle Emperor came to the throne, he issued an edict notifying the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，其王占巴的賴奉金葉表朝貢，且告安南侵掠， 請降敕戒諭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, King Zhanbadilai came with a gold-leaf memorial to offer tribute, and moreover reported Annam's raids and plunder, requesting that a restraining edict be sent to warn them.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1, King Zhanbadilai came to court with a gold-leaf memorial, offering tribute and reporting Annam's raids; he asked that an imperial edict be sent to restrain Annam.

sentences.zh: 帝可之，遣行人蔣賓興、王樞使其國，賜以絨、錦、織金文綺、紗羅。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved it and dispatched the couriers Jiang Binxing and Wang Shu as envoys to their country, granting velour, brocade, brocaded silk, and gauze and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and sent couriers Jiang Binxing and Wang Shu as envoys to Champa, bestowing velvets, brocades, gold-thread silks, gauzes, and silks.

sentences.zh: 明年，以安南王胡牴奏，詔戢兵，遣官諭占城王。

translations.literal: The next year, upon the memorial of Annam's king Hu Di, an edict ordered cessation of troops, and officials were dispatched to instruct the King of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, at the memorial of Annam's king Hu Di, an edict ordered a halt to hostilities, and officials were sent to notify the King of Champa.

sentences.zh: 而王遣使奏：「安南不遵詔旨， 以舟師來侵，朝貢人回，賜物悉遭奪掠。

translations.literal: But the king dispatched envoys memorializing: 'Annam does not follow the edict's intent; with a fleet it came to invade; when the tribute envoys returned, all granted goods were seized and plundered.'
translations.idiomatic: The king then sent envoys reporting: "Annam has ignored the imperial command and sent warships to invade us. When our tribute mission returned, every gift they carried was seized."

sentences.zh: 又畀臣冠服、印章，俾為臣屬。

translations.literal: Moreover they gave me crown robes and a seal, making me their subject.
translations.idiomatic: "They also gave me robes and a seal of office, seeking to reduce me to their vassal."

sentences.zh: 且已據臣 沙離牙諸地，更侵掠未已，臣恐不能自存。

translations.literal: Moreover they have already occupied my lands of Shaliya and others, and their raids and plunder have not ceased; I fear I cannot preserve myself.
translations.idiomatic: "They have already seized my territories around Shaliya and continue their raids without end. I fear I cannot survive."

sentences.zh: 乞隸版圖，遣官往治。

translations.literal: I beg to be enrolled within the imperial domain and that officials be dispatched to govern.
translations.idiomatic: "I beg to be brought under direct imperial rule and to have officials sent to govern us."

sentences.zh: 」帝怒，敕責胡 牴，而賜占城王鈔幣。

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, rebuked Hu Di by edict, and granted paper money to the King of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was furious; he rebuked Hu Di by edict and rewarded the King of Champa with paper money.

sentences.zh: 四年貢白象方物，復告安南之難。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they offered a white elephant and local products, again reporting Annam's difficulties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year they sent a white elephant and other tribute goods, again pleading their plight against Annam.

sentences.zh: 帝大發兵往討，敕占城嚴兵境上，遏其越逸， 獲者即送京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor greatly raised troops to go punish them, and ordered Champa to tighten troops on the border, intercepting their fleeing beyond bounds; those captured were immediately to be sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mobilized a large force to punish Annam and ordered Champa to guard its frontier strictly, intercept fugitives, and send captives at once to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五年攻取安南所侵地，獲賊黨胡烈、潘麻休等獻俘闕下，貢方物謝 恩。

translations.literal: In the fifth year they attacked and recovered the lands Annam had invaded, captured the rebel band Hu Lie, Pan Maxiu, and others, and presented the captives below the palace gate; they offered local products in thanks for grace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year they recaptured territory seized by Annam, captured rebels including Hu Lie and Pan Maxiu, and presented the prisoners at court, sending tribute in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其助兵討逆，遣中官王貴通齎敕及銀幣賜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised their assisting troops in punishing rebellion and dispatched the eunuch Wang Guitong bearing an edict and silver gifts to grant them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended their help in suppressing the rebels and sent eunuch Wang Guitong with an edict and silver gifts.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄭和使其國。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zheng He was sent as envoy to their country.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Zheng He was dispatched on a mission to Champa.

sentences.zh: 王遣其孫舍楊該貢象及方物謝恩。

translations.literal: The king dispatched his grandson She Yang Gai to offer elephants and local products in thanks for grace.
translations.idiomatic: The king sent his grandson She Yang Gai with elephants and tribute goods to express gratitude.

sentences.zh: 十年，其貢使乞冠帶， 予之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, their tribute envoys requested official headgear and belts; they were granted them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the tribute envoys requested Ming official caps and belts, which were granted.

sentences.zh: 覆命鄭和使其國。

translations.literal: Again he ordered Zheng He to be sent as envoy to their country.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng He was again ordered to visit the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 十三年，王師方征陳季擴，命占城助兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, as the imperial army was campaigning against Chen Jikuo, Champa was ordered to assist with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, while imperial forces were campaigning against Chen Jikuo, Champa was ordered to provide military aid.

sentences.zh: 尚書陳洽言：「其王陰懷二心，愆期 不進，反以金帛、戰象資季擴，季擴以黎蒼女遺之。

translations.literal: Minister Chen Qia said: 'Its king secretly harbored a divided heart, missed the deadline and did not advance, and instead with gold, silk, and war elephants supplied Chen Jikuo; Chen Jikuo gave him the daughter of Li Cang.'
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Chen Qia reported: "The king secretly wavered in loyalty, failed to march on schedule, and instead supplied Chen Jikuo with gold, silk, and war elephants; in return Chen Jikuo gave him the daughter of Le Cang."

sentences.zh: 復約季擴舅陳翁挺侵昇華府所 轄四州十一縣地。

translations.literal: They again agreed with Chen Jikuo's maternal uncle Chen Wengting to invade four prefectures and eleven counties under the jurisdiction of Shenghua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He also conspired with Chen Jikuo's uncle Chen Wengting to invade four prefectures and eleven counties under Shenghua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 厥罪維均，宜遣兵致討。

translations.literal: Their crimes are equally grave; troops ought to be dispatched to go punish them.
translations.idiomatic: "Their offenses are equally grave; an expedition should be sent against them."

sentences.zh: 」帝以交址初平，不欲勞師，但賜敕切 責，俾還侵地，王即遣使謝罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Jiaozhi had just been pacified and he did not wish to weary the army, only granted an edict sharply rebuking him, ordering return of the invaded lands; the king immediately dispatched envoys to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, having just pacified Jiaozhi and unwilling to strain his armies further, sent only a stern edict demanding the return of seized territory; the king at once sent envoys to apologize.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遣其孫舍那挫來朝。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he dispatched his grandson She Nachuo to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he sent his grandson She Nachuo to court.

sentences.zh: 命中官林貴、行人倪 俊送歸，有賜。

translations.literal: He ordered the eunuch Lin Gui and the courier Ni Jun to escort him in returning; there were grants.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered eunuch Lin Gui and courier Ni Jun to escort him home with gifts.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，行人黃原昌往頒正朔，繩其王不恪，卻所酬金幣以歸，擢戶部員外 郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, the courier Huang Yuanchang went to promulgate the correct calendar; he rebuked the king for lack of reverence, refused the gold and gifts offered in return, and was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1, courier Huang Yuanchang went to deliver the calendar; finding the king insufficiently deferential, he refused the gold and gifts offered him and was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，瓊州知府程瑩言：「占城比年一貢，勞費實多。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, Qiongzhou Prefect Cheng Ying said: 'Champa in recent years offers tribute once a year; the labor and expense are truly great.'
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1, Qiongzhou prefect Cheng Ying memorialized: "Champa has been sending tribute every year lately, and the burden in labor and expense is heavy."

sentences.zh: 乞如暹羅諸國例， 三年一貢。

translations.literal: I request that it follow the precedent of Siam and other countries, with tribute once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: "I ask that it be allowed the same three-year tribute interval as Siam and the other kingdoms."

sentences.zh: 」帝是之，敕其使如瑩言，賜王及妃彩幣。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved it and instructed their envoys according to Cheng Ying's words, granting colored silks to the king and consort.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed, instructed the Champa envoys accordingly, and granted colored silks to the king and queen.

sentences.zh: 然番人利中國市易，雖有此 令，迄不遵。

translations.literal: Yet the foreigners profited from trade with China; although there was this order, in the end they did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: But the foreigners profited from trade with China, and despite the order they never complied.

sentences.zh: 六年，王占巴的賴卒，其孫摩訶賁該以遺命遣王孫述提昆來朝貢，且乞嗣位。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, King Zhanbadilai died; his grandson Mohebengai, according to the testamentary command, dispatched the royal grandson Shutikun to come to court offering tribute, and moreover requested succession to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year King Zhanbadilai died; his grandson Mohebengai, acting on the late king's will, sent royal grandson Shutikun to court with tribute and a request to succeed to the throne.

sentences.zh: 乃遣給事中管曈、行人吳惠齎詔，封為王，新王及妃並有賜。

translations.literal: Thereupon supervising secretary Guan Tan and courier Wu Hui were dispatched bearing an edict, investing him as king; the new king and consort both received grants.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Guan Tan and courier Wu Hui were sent with an edict investing him as king; the new king and his consort both received imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 七年春，述提昆卒於 途，帝憫之，遣官賜祭。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, Shutikun died on the road; the Emperor showed compassion and dispatched officials to grant sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year Shutikun died en route; the Emperor took pity and sent officials to perform funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 八年遣從子且揚樂催貢舞牌旗黑象。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he dispatched his nephew Qie Yang Le to urge tribute, presenting dance plaques, flags, and a black elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year his nephew Qie Yang Le came to deliver tribute, bringing dance plaques, banners, and a black elephant.

sentences.zh: 十一年，敕諭摩訶賁該曰：「邇者，安南王黎浚遣使奏王欺其孤幼，曩已侵升、 華、思、義四州，今又屢攻化州，掠其人畜財物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict instructed Mohebengai, saying: 'Recently, Annam's king Le Tuan dispatched envoys memorializing that the King bullied his youth and isolation; already in the past he invaded the four prefectures of Sheng, Hua, Si, and Yi, and now again repeatedly attacks Hua Prefecture, plundering its people, livestock, and goods.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict addressed Mohebengai: "Recently the Annam king Le Tuan reported that you have preyed upon his youth and isolation. You already seized the four prefectures of Sheng, Hua, Si, and Yi, and now you repeatedly attack Hua Prefecture, looting people, livestock, and property."

sentences.zh: 二國俱受朝命，各有分疆，豈可 興兵構怨，乖睦鄰保境之義。

translations.literal: Both countries alike receive court commands and each have allotted territories—how can you raise troops and nurture grievances, violating the meaning of harmonious neighbors and preserving borders?
translations.idiomatic: "Both realms hold commissions from the court and fixed borders. How can you take up arms and nurse enmity, betraying the duty of neighborly peace?"

sentences.zh: 王宜祗循禮分，嚴飭邊臣，毋恣肆侵軼，貽禍生靈。

translations.literal: The King ought reverently to follow ritual propriety, strictly admonish border officials, and not wantonly invade and overrun, bringing calamity upon the living people.
translations.idiomatic: "You must observe the proper bounds of conduct, discipline your frontier officials, and cease reckless raids that bring suffering to the people."

sentences.zh: 」 並諭安南嚴行備御，毋挾私報復。

translations.literal: Annam was also instructed to strictly carry out defense preparations and not harbor private revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Annam, too, was ordered to strengthen its defenses and refrain from private retaliation.

sentences.zh: 先是，定三年一貢之例，其國不遵。

translations.literal: Earlier, the precedent of tribute once every three years had been fixed, but their country did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: The three-year tribute interval had already been established, but Champa ignored it.

sentences.zh: 及詰其使者， 則云：「先王已逝，前敕無存，故不知此令。

translations.literal: When their envoys were questioned, they then said: 'The former king had already passed away, and the earlier edict no longer existed, so we did not know this order.'
translations.idiomatic: When the envoys were questioned, they replied: "Our late king had died and the earlier edict was no longer at hand, so we did not know of the rule."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，貢使復至，再敕王遵制，賜 王及妃彩幣。

translations.literal: That year, tribute envoys again arrived; the king was again instructed to follow the regulation, and the king and consort were granted colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute envoys came again; the king was once more ordered to obey the regulation, and he and his consort received colored silks.

sentences.zh: 冬復遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In winter envoys were again dispatched to come offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter envoys came again with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年，王與安南戰，大敗被執。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the king fought Annam, suffered a great defeat, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the king fought Annam, was utterly defeated, and taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 故王占巴的賴侄摩訶貴來遣使奏：「先王抱 疾，曾以臣為世子，欲令嗣位。

translations.literal: The former king Zhanbadilai's nephew Mohegui came and dispatched envoys memorializing: 'The former king, stricken with illness, had already taken me as crown prince, intending to have me succeed to the throne.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhanbadilai's nephew Mohegui sent envoys reporting: "When the late king fell ill, he had already named me crown prince and intended that I should succeed him."

sentences.zh: 臣時年幼，遜位於舅氏摩訶賁該。

translations.literal: At that time I was still young, and I yielded the throne to my maternal uncle Mohebencai.
translations.idiomatic: I was still young at the time, and I yielded the throne to my maternal uncle, Mohebencai.

sentences.zh: 後屢興兵伐安南， 致敵兵入舊州古壘等處，殺掠人畜殆盡，王亦被擒。

translations.literal: Later he repeatedly raised troops to attack Annam, causing enemy soldiers to enter Jiuzhou, Gulei, and other places, killing and plundering people and livestock almost to extinction; the king was also captured.
translations.idiomatic: He later launched repeated campaigns against Annam, which brought enemy forces into Jiuzhou, Gulei, and other districts, where they slaughtered and plundered until nearly all people and livestock were gone; the king himself was also taken captive.

sentences.zh: 國人以臣先王之侄，且有遺命， 請臣代位。

translations.literal: The people of the state, because I was the former king's nephew and there was also a final charge, requested that I take the throne in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Because I was the late king's nephew and he had left a final charge, the people asked me to take the throne in his stead.

sentences.zh: 辭之再三，不得已始於府前治事。

translations.literal: I declined again and again; only when there was no alternative did I begin to conduct affairs before the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: I refused repeatedly, and only when I could not do otherwise did I begin to govern from before the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢自專，伏候朝命。

translations.literal: I dare not act on my own authority and humbly await the command of the court.
translations.idiomatic: I dare not assume authority on my own and humbly await the imperial command.

sentences.zh: 」乃遣給事 中陳誼、行人薛干封為王，諭以保國交鄰，並諭國中臣民共相輔翼。

translations.literal: " The court thereupon dispatched Supervising Secretary Chen Yi and Envoy Xue Ganfeng to invest him as king, instructing him to preserve the state and maintain relations with neighboring states, and also instructing the officials and people within the country to support one another.
translations.idiomatic: The court then sent Supervising Secretary Chen Yi and Envoy Xue Ganfeng to invest him as king, exhorting him to guard the realm and maintain good relations with his neighbors, and urging the officials and people of the country to assist one another.

sentences.zh: 十三年敕安南 送摩訶賁該還國，不奉命。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year an edict ordered Annam to send Mohebencai back to his country; it did not obey the command.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the court ordered Annam to send Mohebencai home, but Annam refused to comply.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年遣使來貢，且告王訃。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai envoys were sent to offer tribute and also to announce the king's death.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 3 envoys came to pay tribute and also reported the king's death.

sentences.zh: 命給事中潘本愚、行人邊永封其弟摩訶貴由為 王。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Pan Benyu and Envoy Bian Yong were ordered to invest his younger brother Moheguiyou as king.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Supervising Secretary Pan Benyu and Envoy Bian Yong to invest his younger brother, Moheguiyou, as king.

sentences.zh: 天順元年入貢，賜其正副使钑花金帶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun they came to offer tribute, and the chief and deputy envoys were granted gold belts with chased floral designs.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 they presented tribute, and the chief and deputy envoys were granted gold belts with chased floral designs.

sentences.zh: 二年，王摩訶槃羅悅新立，遣使奉表朝 貢。

translations.literal: In the second year the newly enthroned King Mohepanluoyue dispatched envoys presenting a memorial to pay court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the newly enthroned king Mohepanluoyue sent envoys with a memorial to pay tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 四年復貢，自正使以下賜紗帽及金銀角帶有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they offered tribute again; from the chief envoy downward, gauze caps and gold or silver belts were granted in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year they presented tribute again, and from the chief envoy on down, gauze caps and gold or silver belts were bestowed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 使者訴安南見侵，因敕諭安南 王。

translations.literal: The envoys complained that they were being invaded by Annam; therefore an edict of instruction was issued to the King of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys complained of invasion by Annam, whereupon the court issued an edict of admonition to the king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 九月，使來，告王喪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month envoys came and announced the king's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month envoys arrived and reported the king's death.

sentences.zh: 命給事中黃汝霖、行人劉恕封王弟槃羅茶全為王。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Huang Rulin and Envoy Liu Shu were ordered to invest the king's younger brother Panluochachuan as king.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Supervising Secretary Huang Rulin and Envoy Liu Shu to invest the king's younger brother, Panluochachuan, as king.

sentences.zh: 八年入貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year they came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 憲宗嗣位，應頒賜蕃國錦幣，禮官請付使臣齎回，從之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzong succeeded to the throne, the brocades and silks due to be granted to foreign tributary states were to be distributed; the officials of rites requested that they be entrusted to the envoys to carry back, and the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xianzong Emperor took the throne, the customary gifts of brocade and silk for tributary states were due; the Ministry of Rites asked that they be given to the envoys to carry home, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 使者復訴 安南見侵，求索白象。

translations.literal: The envoys again complained of invasion by Annam and requested a white elephant.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys again petitioned about Annam's invasions and asked that a white elephant be granted.

sentences.zh: 乞如永樂時，遣官安撫，建立界牌石，以杜侵陵。

translations.literal: They begged that, as in the Yongle period, officials be dispatched to pacify the border and boundary marker stones be erected to prevent invasion.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that officials be sent, as in the Yongle reign, to pacify the border and erect boundary marker stones to stop further incursions.

sentences.zh: 兵部以兩 國方爭，不便遣使，乞令使臣歸諭國王，務循禮法，固封疆，捍外侮，毋輕構禍， 從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said that since the two states were then in conflict it was inconvenient to dispatch envoys, and requested that the envoys be sent back to instruct the king to observe ritual and law, secure the borders, resist external aggression, and not lightly provoke disaster; the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War argued that since the two countries were already at odds, it would be ill-advised to send envoys, and proposed instead that the returning envoys instruct the king to abide by propriety and law, hold his borders firm, repel external threats, and not rashly court disaster; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 成化五年入貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chenghua they came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 5 they presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 時安南索占城犀象、寶貨，令以事天朝之禮事之。

translations.literal: At that time Annam demanded Champa's rhinoceros horns, elephants, and precious goods, and required Champa to serve it with the same deference owed the celestial court.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Annam was demanding rhinoceros horns, elephants, and other treasures from Champa, and insisting that Champa treat it with the same ritual deference owed to the Ming court.

sentences.zh: 占城不從， 大舉往伐。

translations.literal: Champa refused to comply, and Annam launched a major campaign against it.
translations.idiomatic: Champa refused, and Annam launched a full-scale invasion.

sentences.zh: 七年破其國，執王槃羅茶全及家屬五十餘人，劫印符，大肆焚掠，遂據 其地。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Annam broke their state, seized King Panluochachuan and more than fifty members of his household, plundered the seals and credentials, burned and looted on a great scale, and then occupied the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Annam overran the country, captured King Panluochachuan along with more than fifty of his family members, seized the royal seals and credentials, looted and burned on a massive scale, and then annexed the territory.

sentences.zh: 王弟槃羅茶悅逃山中，遣使告難。

translations.literal: The king's younger brother Panluochayue fled into the mountains and sent envoys to report distress.
translations.idiomatic: The king's younger brother, Panluochayue, fled into the mountains and dispatched envoys to plead for help.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「安南吞併與國，若不為處分， 非惟失占城歸附之心，抑恐啟安南跋扈之志。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War stated: "Annam has swallowed up a state allied with us; if no measures are taken, it will not only cause Champa to lose its heart of allegiance, but may also encourage Annam's overbearing ambitions.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War wrote: "Annam has annexed a state allied to us; if nothing is done, Champa will lose faith in the court, and Annam may only grow bolder in its arrogance.

sentences.zh: 宜遣官齎敕宣諭，還其國王及眷屬。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dispatch officials bearing an imperial edict to proclaim and instruct them, and to restore its king and his dependents.
translations.idiomatic: Officials should be sent with an imperial edict to demand the return of the king and his family.

sentences.zh: 」 帝慮安逆命，令俟貢使至日，賜敕責之。

translations.literal: " The emperor, concerned that Annam might defy the order, directed that when the tribute envoys arrived, an edict of reproof be bestowed on them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, fearing Annam might refuse to obey, ordered that rebuke be delivered by edict only when Annam's tribute envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 八年，以槃羅茶悅請封，命給事中陳峻、行人李珊持節往。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Panluochayue requested investiture, Supervising Secretary Chen Jun and Envoy Li Shan were ordered to go bearing imperial credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, at Panluochayue's request for formal investiture, the court sent Supervising Secretary Chen Jun and Envoy Li Shan with imperial credentials.

sentences.zh: 峻等至新州港，守 者拒之，知其國已為安南所據，改為交南州，乃不敢入。

translations.literal: When Chen Jun and the others reached Xingzhou Harbor, the guards refused them entry; learning that the country had already been seized by Annam and reorganized as Jiaonan Prefecture, they did not dare enter.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jun and his party reached Xingzhou Harbor, but the guards turned them away; learning that Champa had already been occupied by Annam and reorganized as Jiaonan Prefecture, they dared not proceed.

sentences.zh: 十年冬還朝。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, in winter, they returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the tenth year they returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 安南既破占城，復遣兵執槃羅茶悅，立前王孫齋亞麻弗菴為王，以國南邊地予 之。

translations.literal: Annam, having already destroyed Champa, again sent troops to seize Panluochayue, enthroned the former king's grandson Zhaiyama Fuan as king, and granted him the southern borderlands of the former state.
translations.idiomatic: After defeating Champa, Annam sent troops again to capture Panluochayue, installed the former king's grandson Zhaiyama Fuan as king, and allotted him territory along the southern fringe of the old kingdom.

sentences.zh: 十四年，遣使朝貢請封，命給事中馮義、行人張瑾往封之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year envoys were sent to pay court tribute and request investiture; Supervising Secretary Feng Yi and Envoy Zhang Jin were ordered to go and invest him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year envoys came to court to pay tribute and request investiture, and the court appointed Supervising Secretary Feng Yi and Envoy Zhang Jin to invest the new king.

sentences.zh: 義等多攜私物，既 至廣東，聞齋亞麻弗菴已死，其弟古來遣使乞封。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others took much private merchandise with them; upon reaching Guangdong they heard that Zhaiyama Fuan had already died, and that his younger brother Gulai had sent envoys requesting investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yi and his party had loaded themselves with private goods; when they reached Guangdong they learned that Zhaiyama Fuan was already dead and that his younger brother Gulai had sent envoys to request investiture.

sentences.zh: 義等慮空還失利，亟至占城。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others, fearing they would return empty-handed at a loss, hastened to Champa.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the disgrace of returning empty-handed, Feng Yi and his colleagues hurried on to Champa.

sentences.zh: 占 城人言，王孫請封之後，即為古來所殺，安南以偽敕立其國人提婆苔為王。

translations.literal: The people of Champa said that after the king's grandson requested investiture, he was immediately killed by Gulai; Annam, with a forged edict, enthroned a man of their country named Tibota as king.
translations.idiomatic: The Chams reported that the prince who had requested investiture was soon killed by Gulai, and that Annam had used a forged imperial edict to install a local man named Tibota as king.

sentences.zh: 義等不 俟奏報，輒以印幣授提婆苔封之，得所賂黃金百餘兩，又往滿剌加國盡貨其私物以 歸。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others did not wait for a memorial reply; they rashly presented the seal and investiture goods to Tibota and invested him, receiving more than a hundred taels of gold in bribes; they then went to Malacca to sell off all their private goods before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Without awaiting court approval, Feng Yi and his party invested Tibota on the spot with the seals and regalia, took more than a hundred taels of gold in bribes, then sold their private merchandise in Malacca before heading home.

sentences.zh: 義至海洋病死。

translations.literal: Feng Yi died of illness on the ocean.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yi died of illness at sea.

sentences.zh: 瑾具其事，並上偽敕於朝。

translations.literal: Zhang Jin fully reported the affair and also submitted the forged edict to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jin filed a full report and submitted the forged edict to the court.

sentences.zh: 十七年，古來遣使朝貢，言：「安南破臣國時，故王弟槃羅茶悅逃居佛靈山。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Gulai sent envoys to pay court tribute, stating: "When Annam destroyed our country, the former king's younger brother Panluochayue fled to Mount Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Gulai sent envoys to court with tribute, saying: "When Annam overran our kingdom, the former king's brother Panluochayue fled to Mount Fuling.

sentences.zh: 比天使齎封誥至，已為賊人執去，臣與兄齋亞麻弗菴潛竄山谷。

translations.literal: By the time the imperial envoys arrived bearing investiture documents, he had already been seized by bandits; my elder brother Zhaiyama Fuan and I secretly hid in mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the imperial envoys arrived with the patent of investiture, he had already been seized by the enemy; my brother Zhaiyama Fuan and I hid secretly in the hills.

sentences.zh: 後賊人畏懼天威， 遣人訪覓臣兄，還以故地。

translations.literal: Later the bandits, in fear of Heaven's majesty, sent men to search out my elder brother and restored him to his former territory.
translations.idiomatic: Later, fearing the emperor's wrath, the invaders searched out my brother and restored him to part of our former lands.

sentences.zh: 然自邦都郎至占臘止五處，臣兄權國未幾，遽爾隕歿。

translations.literal: However, from Bangdulang to Zhanla there were only five places; my elder brother ruled for only a short while before he suddenly died.
translations.idiomatic: But from Bangdulang to Zhanla we held only five districts; my brother had ruled for scarcely any time when he suddenly died.

sentences.zh: 臣當嗣立，不敢自專，仰望天恩，賜之冊印。

translations.literal: I ought to succeed to the throne; I dare not act on my own authority and look up to Heaven's grace to grant me credentials and a seal.
translations.idiomatic: It falls to me to succeed, but I dare not assume the throne unilaterally; I look to the emperor's grace for investiture and a royal seal.

sentences.zh: 臣國所有土地本二十七處，四府、一 州、二十二縣。

translations.literal: Our state originally possessed land in twenty-seven places: four prefectures, one department, and twenty-two counties.
translations.idiomatic: Our kingdom once comprised twenty-seven administrative units—four prefectures, one department, and twenty-two counties.

sentences.zh: 東至海，南至占臘，西至黎人山，北至阿本喇補，凡三千五百餘里。

translations.literal: East to the sea, south to Zhanla, west to Liren Mountain, north to Aobenlabu—altogether more than three thousand five hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It extended east to the sea, south to Zhanla, west to Liren Mountain, and north to Aobenlabu—a span of more than three thousand five hundred li.

sentences.zh: 乞特諭交人，盡還本國。

translations.literal: We beg that the Jiao people be specially instructed to return all of our native territory.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that the Jiao people be expressly ordered to restore all of our original territory.

sentences.zh: 」章下廷議，英國公張懋等請特遣近臣有威望者二人往使。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent down for court discussion; the Duke of Ying, Zhang Mao, and others requested that two eminent court officials of standing be specially dispatched as envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred for deliberation; the Duke of Ying, Zhang Mao, and others recommended dispatching two senior officials of proven standing.

sentences.zh: 時安南貢使方歸，即賜敕詰責黎灝，令速還地，毋抗朝命。

translations.literal: At that time Annam's tribute envoys were just returning; an edict of interrogation and reproof was immediately bestowed on Le Hao, ordering him to return the land promptly and not resist the court's command.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's tribute envoys had just returned, and the court immediately issued an edict rebuking Le Hao, demanding the immediate return of occupied lands and forbidding defiance of imperial authority.

sentences.zh: 禮官乃劾瑾擅封，執下 詔獄，具得其情，論死。

translations.literal: The officials of rites then impeached Zhang Jin for unauthorized investiture; he was arrested and sent to the imperial prison, the full truth was obtained, and he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites then impeached Zhang Jin for investing Tibota without authorization; he was arrested and sent to the imperial prison, the full facts were established, and he was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 時古來所遣使臣在館，召問之，云：「古來實王弟，其王 病死，非弒。

translations.literal: At that time Gulai's envoys were lodged in the embassy quarters; they were summoned and questioned, and said: "Gulai is indeed the king's younger brother; the king died of illness, not by assassination.
translations.idiomatic: Gulai's envoys were staying at the embassy; summoned for questioning, they said Gulai was indeed the late king's brother, that the king had died of natural causes and had not been murdered.

sentences.zh: 提婆苔不知何人。

translations.literal: We do not know who Tibota is.
translations.idiomatic: They said they had no idea who Tibota was.

sentences.zh: 」乃命使臣暫歸廣東，俟提婆苔使至，審誠偽處之。

translations.literal: " The court then ordered the envoys to return temporarily to Guangdong, to wait until Tibota's envoys arrived, and to determine truth from falsehood in handling the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the envoys to remain temporarily in Guangdong until Tibota's representatives arrived, so the truth could be ascertained.

sentences.zh: 使臣候命經年，提婆苔使者不至，乃令還國。

translations.literal: The envoys waited for orders for a year; Tibota's envoys did not arrive, and the court then ordered them to return to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys waited nearly a year without Tibota sending anyone; the court then allowed them to return home.

sentences.zh: 明年，弘治改元，遣使入貢。

translations.literal: The following year, when Hongzhi began as a reign era, envoys were sent to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, with the beginning of the Hongzhi reign, envoys came to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年遣弟卜古良赴廣東，言：「安南仍肆侵陵， 乞如永樂時遣將督兵守護。

translations.literal: In the second year he sent his younger brother Buguliang to Guangdong, saying: "Annam still wantonly encroaches and invades; we beg that, as in the Yongle period, generals be dispatched to command troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he sent his brother Buguliang to Guangdong with a petition: "Annam continues to invade our borders; we ask that troops be sent, as in the Yongle reign, to guard our realm.

sentences.zh: 」總督秦紘等以聞。

translations.literal: " Governor-General Qin Hong and others reported this to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Qin Hong and others reported the request to the throne.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「安南、占城皆《祖訓》 所載不征之國。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War stated: "Annam and Champa are both among the states that the Ancestral Instructions record as not to be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War argued: "Both Annam and Champa are listed in the Ancestral Instructions as states the dynasty must not invade.

sentences.zh: 永樂間命將出師，乃正黎賊弒逆之罪，非以鄰境交惡之故。

translations.literal: When in the Yongle period troops were ordered to march, it was to punish the Le bandits for regicide and rebellion, not because of disputes along the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongle campaigns were launched to punish the Le usurpers for regicide, not simply because of border disputes between neighbors.

sentences.zh: 今黎灝 修貢惟謹，古來膚受之醞，容有過情，不可信其單詞，勞師不征之國。

translations.literal: Now Le Hao pays tribute with utmost diligence; Gulai's complaints may be overstated and cannot be believed on his word alone; we should not weary the troops against a state we must not attack.
translations.idiomatic: Le Hao has been punctilious in tribute; Gulai's grievances may be exaggerated, and we cannot dispatch armies against a protected state on his say-so alone.

sentences.zh: 宜令守臣回 咨，言近交人殺害王子古蘇麻，王即率眾敗之，仇恥已雪。

translations.literal: It is fitting to have the local officials reply in a consultation, saying that recently the Jiao people killed Prince Gusuma, and the king immediately led his forces to defeat them, so vengeance and shame have already been wiped away.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials should reply that the Jiao recently killed Prince Gusuma, and the king has already led his forces to defeat them and avenge the insult.

sentences.zh: 王宜自強修政，撫飖國 人，保固疆圉，仍與安南惇睦修好。

translations.literal: The king should strengthen himself and improve governance, comfort and settle the distressed people of the state, secure the borders, and still cultivate friendly relations with Annam in good faith.
translations.idiomatic: The king should strengthen his rule, care for his war-weary people, hold his borders firm, and continue to seek good relations with Annam.

sentences.zh: 其餘嫌細故，悉宜捐除。

translations.literal: All other grievances over minor matters should be entirely set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser grievances should all be put aside.

sentences.zh: 倘不能自強，專藉朝 廷發兵渡海，代王守國，古無是理。

translations.literal: If one cannot strengthen oneself but relies solely on the court sending troops across the sea to guard the state on the king's behalf, there has never been such a principle since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: If he cannot strengthen himself but expects the court to send armies across the sea to defend his kingdom for him, no such precedent exists in history.

sentences.zh: 」帝如其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved as they said.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年遣使謝恩。

translations.literal: In the third year envoys were sent to express thanks for the grace received.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year envoys came to express gratitude.

sentences.zh: 其國自殘破後， 民物蕭條，貢使漸稀。

translations.literal: Since the state had been ravaged and broken, people and goods were desolate and tributary envoys gradually grew scarce.
translations.idiomatic: After the devastation of the kingdom, its people and resources were exhausted, and tribute missions became increasingly rare.

sentences.zh: 十二，年遣使奏：「本國新州港之地，仍為安南侵奪，患方未息。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year envoys memorialized: "The territory of Xingzhou Harbor in our country is still being seized and robbed by Annam; the disaster has not yet ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year envoys memorialized: "Our territory at Xingzhou Harbor is still being seized by Annam, and the threat has not abated.

sentences.zh: 臣年已老， 請及臣未死，命長子沙古卜洛襲封，庶他日可保國土。

translations.literal: I am already old; I request that while I am not yet dead, my eldest son Shagubuluo be ordered to succeed and receive investiture, so that someday the national territory may be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: I am growing old and ask that, before I die, my eldest son Shagubuluo be invested as my successor so that our lands may yet be preserved.

sentences.zh: 」廷議：「安南為占城患， 已非一日。

translations.literal: " The court deliberated: "Annam has been Champa's affliction for many a day now.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated: "Annam's aggression against Champa is nothing new.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘗因占城之醞，累降璽書，曲垂誨諭。

translations.literal: The court has repeatedly, on account of Champa's complaints, issued imperial letters, bending to bestow admonition and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly at Champa's urging, the court has issued imperial edicts of patient guidance.

sentences.zh: 安南前後奏報，皆言祗承朝 命，土地人民，悉已退還。

translations.literal: Annam's successive memorial reports have all stated that they reverently accept the court's commands and that land and people have all been returned.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's repeated memorials claim full compliance and the return of all occupied lands and people.

sentences.zh: 然安南辨釋之語方至，而占城控訴之詞又聞，恐真有不 獲已之情。

translations.literal: Yet no sooner have Annam's explanatory words just arrived than Champa's petitions of complaint are heard again; one fears there may truly be situations of unavoidable necessity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet scarcely has Annam's defense arrived when Champa complains again—suggesting that Annam may indeed feel it has no choice but to hold the land.

sentences.zh: 宜仍令守臣切諭安南，毋貪人土地，自貽禍殃，否則議遣偏師往問其罪。

translations.literal: It is fitting still to order the local officials sternly to instruct Annam not to covet others' territory and bring disaster upon itself; otherwise the court should consider sending a punitive force to demand an accounting of their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials should again warn Annam not to seize foreign territory at its own peril; otherwise the court should consider dispatching a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 至占城王長子，無父在襲封之理。

translations.literal: As for the eldest son of the King of Champa, there is no precedent for investiture to succeed while the father is still alive.
translations.idiomatic: As for the king of Champa's eldest son, there is no precedent for investing an heir while the father still lives.

sentences.zh: 請令先立為世子攝國事，俟他日當襲位時，如例 請封。

translations.literal: It is requested that he first be established as heir apparent to administer state affairs; when the day comes that he should inherit the throne, investiture should be requested according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He should be named crown prince and regent for now, and seek formal investiture only when succession becomes due.

sentences.zh: 」帝報允。

translations.literal: " The emperor replied granting approval.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 尋遣王孫沙不登古魯來貢。

translations.literal: Soon after, the king's grandson Shabudeng Gulu was sent to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the king's grandson Shabudeng Gulu came to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年，古來卒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Gulai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Gulai died.

sentences.zh: 子沙古卜洛遣使來貢，不告父喪，但乞命大臣往其國，仍以 新州港諸地封之。

translations.literal: His son Shagubuluo sent envoys to pay tribute, not reporting his father's death, but only requesting that great ministers be sent to his country and that he be invested with the lands of Xingzhou Harbor and other territories.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shagubuluo sent tribute envoys who omitted mention of their father's death but asked that senior ministers come to Champa to invest him, including restoration of Xingzhou Harbor and other lost territories.

sentences.zh: 別有佔奪方輿之奏，微及父卒事。

translations.literal: Separately there was a memorial about seized territory, which lightly touched on the father's death.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate petition about seized lands they briefly alluded to the king's death.

sentences.zh: 給事中任良弼等言：「占城前 因國土削弱，假貢乞封，仰仗天威，詟伏鄰國。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Ren Liangbi and others stated: "Champa, because its territory had been weakened, previously used tribute to request investiture, relying on Heaven's majesty to overawe neighboring states.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Ren Liangbi and others argued: "Champa has long exploited tribute missions to request investiture, using imperial prestige to intimidate its neighbors, especially when weakened.

sentences.zh: 其實國王之立不立，不繫朝廷之封 不封也。

translations.literal: In truth whether a king is enthroned or not does not depend on whether the court grants investiture or not.
translations.idiomatic: In truth, whether a king holds power in Champa does not depend on whether the court grants a seal.

sentences.zh: 今稱古來已歿，虛實難知。

translations.literal: Now it is claimed Gulai is already dead; truth and falsehood are hard to know.
translations.idiomatic: Now they claim Gulai is dead, but this cannot be verified.

sentences.zh: 萬一我使至彼，古來尚存，將遂封其子乎？

translations.literal: If by chance our envoys reach there and Gulai is still alive, shall we then invest his son?
translations.idiomatic: If our envoy arrives and Gulai is still alive, are we to invest his son anyway?

sentences.zh: 抑 義不可而已乎？

translations.literal: Or is it that righteousness forbids doing so?
translations.idiomatic: Or would doing so violate all propriety?

sentences.zh: 迫脅之間，事極難處。

translations.literal: Caught in constraint and coercion, the matter would be extremely difficult to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Either way, the court would face an impossible bind.

sentences.zh: 如往時科臣林霄之使滿剌加，不肯北面屈膝， 幽餓而死，迄不能問其罪。

translations.literal: As when in former times Academician Lin Xiao was sent to Malacca—the ruler refused to bow facing north and kneel, and Lin starved to death in confinement; to the end his culprits could not be called to account.
translations.idiomatic: Recall Academician Lin Xiao's mission to Malacca: when the ruler refused to submit, Lin was imprisoned and starved to death, and the court could never punish those responsible.

sentences.zh: 君命國威，不可不慎。

translations.literal: Imperial command and national prestige—one cannot but be cautious.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial authority and national prestige are at stake; we must proceed with caution.

sentences.zh: 大都海外諸蕃，無事則廢朝貢而 自立，有事則假朝貢而請封。

translations.literal: Generally speaking, among the various maritime foreign states, when there is peace they neglect court tribute and enthrone themselves; when there is trouble they use court tribute to request investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Most overseas tributaries ignore the court when all is well and enthrone themselves, but invoke tribute and request investiture when in trouble.

sentences.zh: 今者貢使之來，豈急於求封，不過欲復安南之侵地， 還粵東之逃人耳。

translations.literal: On this occasion the coming of tribute envoys—is it that they urgently seek investiture? It is nothing more than wishing to recover land seized by Annam and recover fugitives in eastern Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: This tribute mission is scarcely about investiture at all; they mainly want recovered territory from Annam and the return of fugitives sheltering in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 夫安南侵地，璽書屢諭歸還，佔據如故。

translations.literal: As for Annam's seized territory, imperial letters have repeatedly ordered its return, yet occupation remains as before.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial edicts have repeatedly demanded that Annam return seized lands, yet it continues to occupy them.

sentences.zh: 今若再諭，彼將玩視之， 天威褻矣。

translations.literal: If we admonish them again now, they will treat it lightly, and Heaven's majesty will be profaned.
translations.idiomatic: Further empty admonitions will only invite contempt and diminish imperial prestige.

sentences.zh: 倘我使往封占城，羈留不遣，求為處分，朝廷將何以應？

translations.literal: If our envoys go to invest Champa and are detained and not sent back, demanding that action be taken, how will the court respond?
translations.idiomatic: If we send envoys to invest the king and they are detained as hostages, what could the court do?

sentences.zh: 又或拘我使者， 令索逃人，是以天朝之貴臣，質於海外之蠻邦。

translations.literal: Or again they may detain our envoys and demand fugitives in exchange—thus treating the court's honored ministers as hostages in barbarian states overseas.
translations.idiomatic: Or our envoys could be held hostage until fugitives are handed over—making senior Ming officials pledges in the hands of distant barbarians.

sentences.zh: 宜如往年古來就封廣東事，令其領 敕歸國，於計為便。

translations.literal: It is fitting, as in the former year when Gulai received investiture in Guangdong, to have them receive an edict and return to their country; this is the expedient course.
translations.idiomatic: The prudent course is the Guangdong investiture precedent used for Gulai: let them receive the edict at the border and return home.

sentences.zh: 」禮部亦以古來存亡未明，請令廣東守臣移文占城勘報，從之， 既而封事久不行。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Rites also, because Gulai's survival was unclear, requested that Guangdong officials send documents to Champa for investigation and report; the emperor assented, but subsequently the investiture was long delayed without being carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites, noting that Gulai's fate was uncertain, also asked Guangdong officials to inquire in Champa; the emperor agreed, but the investiture was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 正德五年，沙古卜洛遣叔父沙系把麻入貢，因請封。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengde Shagubuluo sent his uncle Shaxibama to pay tribute and also request investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 5, Shagubuluo sent his uncle Shaxibama to pay tribute and request investiture.

sentences.zh: 命給事中李貫、行人劉廷 瑞往。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Li Guan and Envoy Liu Tingrui were ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Supervising Secretary Li Guan and Envoy Liu Tingrui to proceed.

sentences.zh: 貫抵廣東憚行，請如往年古來故事，令其使臣領封。

translations.literal: When Li Guan reached Guangdong he feared to proceed and requested that, following the precedent of Gulai in former years, the envoys be allowed to receive investiture there.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Guan reached Guangdong he balked at the journey and asked that the envoys receive investiture locally, as Gulai had done years before.

sentences.zh: 廷議：「遣官已二年， 今若中止，非興滅繼絕義。

translations.literal: The court deliberated: "Officials have already been dispatched for two years; if we stop now, this is not the principle of restoring extinguished states and continuing broken lines."
translations.idiomatic: The court debated the matter and concluded: "Envoys have been on this mission for two years already. To halt it now would violate the duty to restore a fallen state and preserve its royal line."

sentences.zh: 倘其使不願領封，或領歸而受非其人，重起事端，益傷 國體，宜令貫等亟往。

translations.literal: If their envoy is unwilling to receive the investiture, or returns and invests someone who is not the right person, trouble will arise anew and further harm national dignity; Guan and the others should be ordered to go at once.
translations.idiomatic: If the Champa envoy refuses to carry the patent home, or invests the wrong man on arrival, fresh trouble will erupt and further damage the dynasty's standing. Li Guan and his party should be sent out immediately.

sentences.zh: 」貫終憚行，以乏通事、火長為詞。

translations.literal: " Guan still feared going and pleaded the lack of interpreters and helmsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan still refused to travel, citing the lack of interpreters and ship pilots.

sentences.zh: 廷議令廣東守臣採訪其 人，如終不得，則如舊例行。

translations.literal: The court ordered Guangdong frontier officials to seek out such persons; if they still could not be found, the matter was to follow the old established practice.
translations.idiomatic: The court instructed the Guangdong authorities to locate suitable men; if none could be found, the old precedent would apply.

sentences.zh: 貫復設詞言：「臣奉命五載，似憚風波之險，殊不知 占城自古來被逐後，竄居赤崁邦都郎，國非舊疆，勢不可往。

translations.literal: Guan again made excuses, saying: "Your subject has borne this commission for five years and may seem to fear the perils of wind and wave, yet he is unaware that after Gulai was driven out of Champa he fled to Chi'kan Bandurang—the country is not the old territory, and the circumstances make going impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan raised new objections: "Your servant has held this commission for five years and may appear to shrink from the dangers of the sea, but the real issue is that since Gulai was expelled from Champa he has taken refuge at Chi'kan Bandurang. That is no longer the old kingdom, and the mission cannot realistically proceed there."

sentences.zh: 況古來乃前王齋亞麻 弗菴之頭目，殺王而奪其位。

translations.literal: Moreover, Gulai was merely a subordinate of the former king Zhiya-ma-fuan; he killed the king and seized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Gulai was only a lieutenant of the late King Zhiya-ma-fuan. He murdered his sovereign and usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 王有三子，其一尚存，義又不可。

translations.literal: The king had three sons, and one still survives, so on principle this cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: The king had three sons, and one of them is still alive. On principle, investiture is out of the question.

sentences.zh: 律以《春秋》之法， 雖不興問罪之師，亦必絕朝貢之使。

translations.literal: Measured by the principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals, even if we do not raise an army to punish the wrong, we must at least cut off tribute missions to the court.
translations.idiomatic: By the standards of the Spring and Autumn Annals, even if we do not send a punitive expedition, we ought at minimum to sever tributary relations.

sentences.zh: 奈何又為採訪之議，徒延歲月，於事無益。

translations.literal: Why then revive the proposal to seek out personnel? It would only waste months and accomplish nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Why reopen the search for interpreters and pilots? That would only drag out the affair for months without achieving anything.

sentences.zh: 」 廣東巡按丁楷亦附會具奏，廷議從之。

translations.literal: " The Guangdong touring censor Ding Kai also echoed this in a memorial, and the court adopted the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong touring censor Ding Kai filed a supporting memorial, and the court accepted the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 十年令其使臣齎敕往，自是遂為故事，其國 貢使亦不常至。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the order was given for its envoy to carry the investiture edict back, and this thereafter became the established practice; tribute envoys from the kingdom no longer came regularly.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 10 the court ordered the Champa envoy to carry the investiture edict home himself. That became the standing practice, and tribute missions from the kingdom were no longer sent on a regular basis.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十二年遣王叔沙不登古魯來貢，訴數為安南侵擾，道阻難歸。

translations.literal: In Jiajing 22 the king's uncle Sa Bu-deng Gu-lu came to pay tribute, complaining that Annam had repeatedly harassed them and that the route home was blocked and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 22 the king's uncle Sa Budeng Gulu arrived with tribute, reporting repeated Annamese raids and pleading that the homeward route had become too dangerous.

sentences.zh: 乞遣官護 送還國，報可。

translations.literal: He requested that officials be sent to escort them home; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that officials be dispatched to escort him home. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 其國無霜雪，四時皆似夏，草木常青。

translations.literal: The country knows no frost or snow; all four seasons are like summer, and grass and trees stay green throughout the year.
translations.idiomatic: The country never sees frost or snow. Every season feels like summer, and the vegetation stays green year-round.

sentences.zh: 民以漁為業，無二麥，力穡者少，故收 獲薄。

translations.literal: The people make their living by fishing; there is no double-cropping of grain, few labor diligently at farming, and so harvests are sparse.
translations.idiomatic: The people live mainly by fishing. They do not grow a second grain crop, few work hard at agriculture, and yields are accordingly meager.

sentences.zh: 國人皆食檳榔，終日不離口。

translations.literal: All the people chew betel nut and never leave it from their mouths all day long.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone chews betel nut and keeps it in the mouth from morning to night.

sentences.zh: 不解朔望，但以月生為初，月晦為盡，不置閏。

translations.literal: They do not understand new and full moons; they take the moon's waxing as the month's beginning and its waning as its end, and they do not add intercalary months.
translations.idiomatic: They have no concept of new and full moons. They treat the moon's waxing as the start of the month and its waning as the end, and they do not intercalate months.

sentences.zh: 分晝夜為十更，非日中不起，非夜分不臥，見月則飲酒、歌舞為樂。

translations.literal: They divide day and night into ten watches; they do not rise before noon nor go to bed before midnight; when the moon appears they drink wine and sing and dance for pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Day and night are divided into ten watches. No one rises before midday or sleeps before midnight. When the moon is out, they drink, sing, and dance for amusement.

sentences.zh: 無紙筆，用羊 皮槌薄燻黑，削細竹蘸白灰為字，狀若蚯蚓。

translations.literal: They have no paper or brush; they beat sheepskin thin and smoke it black, then carve fine bamboo sticks, dip them in white ash to write characters shaped like earthworms.
translations.idiomatic: They have no paper or writing brushes. Sheepskin is beaten thin and smoked black; fine bamboo splints are dipped in white ash to form characters that look like wriggling worms.

sentences.zh: 有城郭甲兵，人性狠而狡，貿易多不 平。

translations.literal: They have fortified cities and armed soldiers; the people are fierce and cunning, and trade is often unfair.
translations.idiomatic: The country has walled towns and armed forces. The people are savage and deceitful, and commercial dealings are often dishonest.

sentences.zh: 戶皆北向，民居悉覆茅簷，高不得過三尺。

translations.literal: All doors face north; dwellings are thatched roofs, and may be no higher than three feet.
translations.idiomatic: Every doorway faces north. Houses are thatched with straw and may be no more than three feet high.

sentences.zh: 部領分差等，門高卑亦有限。

translations.literal: Official ranks are divided into grades, and door heights and widths are also restricted by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Official ranks are graded by rank, and the height and width of doorways are likewise limited according to status.

sentences.zh: 飲食 穢污，魚非腐爛不食，釀不生蛆不為美。

translations.literal: Their food and drink are filthy; they will not eat fish unless it has putrefied, and they consider wine unfit unless maggots have bred in it.
translations.idiomatic: Their diet is revolting. They will eat fish only after it has rotted, and they regard wine as inferior unless maggots have formed in it.

sentences.zh: 人體黑，男蓬頭，女椎結，俱跣足。

translations.literal: People's bodies are black; men wear their hair loose, women wear it in topknots, and all go barefoot.
translations.idiomatic: The people have dark skin. Men wear their hair loose, women bind it in topknots, and everyone goes barefoot.

sentences.zh: 王，瑣裡人，崇釋教。

translations.literal: The king is of Saili stock and venerates Buddhism.
translations.idiomatic: The king is a Saili Muslim who reveres Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 歲時採生人膽入酒中，與家人同飲，且以浴身，曰「通 身是膽」。
